mentions.name: terminay
mentions.description: A terminal for macOS and Linux with Chrome-style window management organized around projects at the top level. It provides remote control at the terminal level rather than inside AI harnesses (Claude/OpenAI), lets users write a command once and inject it into any AI CLI with cmd+l, and includes macros for automating repetitive terminal actions.
mentions.problem: Existing terminals like iTerm2 have unsatisfying window management, and AI remote control and commands should live at the terminal level instead of being duplicated inside each AI CLI.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building yet another terminal [1][2] for macOS and Linux. I've been unsatisfied with the window management of iterm2 and other terminals, my one acts a bit more like Chrome with projects at the top level.
